svg.title: How tokenized securities fit together
svg.desc: Four steps. 1 Issue: a company or its agent creates tokens on a shared ledger. 2 Approve buyers: only checked (KYC) wallets can hold the token. 3 Trade and settle, the key step: 3a orders match on an exchange or onchain pool; 3b the buyer's wallet is checked; 3c the token and cash swap at once, so both settle or neither does; 3d balances and the register update. 4 Pay holders: dividends, votes and redemptions reach token holders. Native tokens are the share itself; a wrapper is a claim on a share someone else holds.
